items.original: Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)

title.zh-TW: /keymap 支援自訂前導鍵，快捷鍵提示常駐且語音靜音改為 F9
title.en: /keymap Supports Custom Leader Keys, Sticky Shortcut Prompts, and Moves Voice Mute to F9

body.zh-TW: 習慣用鍵盤快速叫出各種操作的讀者，現在調整自訂按鍵更加得心應手。⟦如同樂團指揮設定了預備拍，以前比劃動作稍縱即逝容易漏看，現在提示手勢會穩穩停在空中等你接招，也把靜音操作換到另一個指定琴鍵。⟧在 `/keymap` 設定中，你可以自由配置前導鍵（按下一組按鍵後等待後續指令的引導鍵），系統預設組合為 `Ctrl+X`。按下後跳出的快捷鍵提示會持續停留在畫面上，直到你做出選擇或取消為止。語音靜音功能則移到了 `F9` 按鍵。
body.en: Readers accustomed to invoking operations swiftly via the keyboard can now customize key bindings with far greater ease. ⟦Imagine an orchestra conductor establishing a preparatory beat: previously the fleeting gesture was easily missed, but now the cueing hand rests steadily in the air waiting for your response, while the mute control is reassigned to another designated piano key.⟧ Within `/keymap` settings, you can freely configure a leader key (a guiding key that waits for follow-up inputs once pressed), with the system defaulting to `Ctrl+X`. The shortcut prompt that appears after pressing it remains on screen until you make a choice or cancel. Voice muting has been moved to the `F9` key.

items.original: Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)

title.zh-TW: /daemon 支援重啟背景伺服器，中斷前主動警告並自動重連
title.en: /daemon Supports Restarting Background Servers with Disruption Warnings and Auto-Reconnect

body.zh-TW: 當背景執行的伺服器連線卡住或需要重載時，你不必再大費周章手動終止處理程序。⟦就像大樓總電源維護前廣播通知，以前電閘一拉整棟直接斷電，現在管理員會先警告哪些電梯與設備即將暫停，重啟完畢後還會自動幫大家把照明重新接通。⟧現在從 `/daemon` 指令就能直接重啟受管的背景伺服器（常駐在系統底層默默運作的背景程序）。重啟前，Codex 會先跳出警告，提醒這次重啟可能會中斷哪些進行中的工作。確認執行後，系統會在伺服器重啟完成時自動重新連線，省去手動重連的繁瑣步驟。
body.en: When a background server connection hangs or requires a reload, you no longer need to go through the hassle of manually killing the process. ⟦Consider a building announcement prior to main electrical maintenance: previously throwing the main switch cut power to the entire building without ceremony, but now the superintendent first warns which elevators and facilities will temporarily halt, and automatically reconnects lighting once the restart completes.⟧ You can now restart managed background servers (daemons running quietly at the system level) directly from the `/daemon` command. Before restarting, Codex displays a warning outlining which active tasks might be disrupted. Once confirmed, the system automatically reconnects as soon as the server finishes rebooting, eliminating tedious manual reconnection steps.

items.original: Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)

title.zh-TW: 唯讀工具支援平行執行，技能、記憶與對話紀錄查詢不再排隊
title.en: Read-Only Tools Support Parallel Execution: Skills, Memory, and Session History Queries No Longer Queue Up

body.zh-TW: 提問時需要 AI 同時調閱多項過往資訊的讀者，現在能感受到明顯更快的查詢反應。⟦跟圖書館調派多位館員同時分頭找書一樣，以前一個人要先找完歷史檔案才能去翻閱典藏技能，現在三位館員各自朝不同書架出發，找齊資料後一口氣交到你手上。⟧Codex 現在能夠平行（同時多工處理而不依序等待）執行彼此互不干擾的獨立唯讀工具。這項機制涵蓋了擴充技能檢索、記憶調閱，以及對話歷史紀錄查詢。這些互不衝突的讀取工作現在能同步展開，縮短等待回答的時間。
body.en: Readers whose questions require the AI to retrieve multiple pieces of past information at once will now notice noticeably faster query responses. ⟦A library dispatches multiple librarians to fetch books simultaneously: where one person previously had to search historical archives before checking archived skills, three librarians now head toward separate shelves at once and deliver everything into your hands the moment it is gathered.⟧ Codex can now execute mutually independent read-only tools in parallel (processing tasks concurrently without waiting in line). This mechanism covers skill retrieval, memory lookups, and session history queries. These non-conflicting read tasks now run concurrently, cutting down the wait time for answers.

items.original: Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)

title.zh-TW: Daybreak 模型對合格帳號預設啟用，codex exec 支援金鑰指定選用
title.en: Daybreak Model Enabled by Default for Eligible Accounts, with Key-Based Selection in codex exec

body.zh-TW: 想體驗最新 Daybreak 模型的讀者，只要帳號符合資格，打開程式就能直接用上。⟦宛若高鐵會員自動升級商務車廂，以前必須特地到櫃檯出示證件申請，現在符合條件的旅客刷票進站就能直接入座，在自動售票機輸入個人憑證也能順利劃位。⟧針對符合資格的帳號，Codex 現已預設啟用 Daybreak 模型。如果你習慣使用終端機指令 `codex exec` 執行任務，在伺服器提供存取權限的前提下，只要附上 OpenAI API 金鑰（存取雲端服務的通關密鑰），也能透過該指令自由選用 Daybreak 模型。
body.en: Readers eager to experience the latest Daybreak model can now use it right out of the box, provided their account is eligible. ⟦A high-speed rail membership automatically upgrades passengers to business class: where travelers once had to present identification at the counter to apply, eligible passengers can now swipe their tickets at the gate to take their seats directly, while entering personal credentials at automated ticketing machines also secures a seat smoothly.⟧ Codex now enables the Daybreak model by default for eligible accounts. If you prefer running tasks with the terminal command `codex exec`, you can also freely select the Daybreak model through that command by supplying an OpenAI API key (the secret pass for accessing cloud services), provided the server grants access.

items.original: Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

title.zh-TW: 對話串切換支援 /side 回到分支，重啟時完整恢復授權與網路許可
title.en: Thread Switching Supports /side to Return to Branches, Fully Restoring Authorizations and Network Permissions on Reopen

body.zh-TW: 頻繁在多個任務之間切換對話串（在同一專案中分頭進行的獨立對話紀錄）的讀者，現在不用擔心進度與設定跑位。⟦有如在辦公室借調多份專案公文，以前換個案子審核印章就得重新蓋過，現在換回舊案能直接調閱已批准的用印紀錄，派出去的公文回函也會精準送回當初發文的專案夾。⟧切換對話串後，你可以隨時輸入 `/side` 指令回到先前的旁支對話。如果切換前有尚未回覆完畢的提示詞，產生的答案也會準確送回當初提問的對話串。當你重新打開已保存的對話串時，先前擁有的權限與網路存取許可都會完整還原，同時依然遵守手動覆寫與現行的管理政策。
body.en: Readers who frequently switch between threads (independent conversation logs running concurrently in the same project) no longer need to worry about losing progress or configuration state. ⟦Handling multiple project dossiers in an office setting once required restamping approvals whenever you switched cases, but returning to an earlier case now pulls up previously approved seal records directly, and replies to dispatched memos return precisely to the originating project folder.⟧ After switching threads, you can type the `/side` command at any point to return to a previous side discussion. If a prompt was still generating when you switched, the resulting response is routed accurately back to the thread where the question originated. When reopening a saved thread, your previously granted authorizations and network access permissions are fully restored, while continuing to respect manual overrides and active administrative policies.

items.original:
Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)

title.zh-TW: 網路代理加強防護：DNS 查詢前先審核、阻擋重複標頭與憑證別名繞過
title.en: Network Proxy Security Tightens: Pre-DNS Query Audits, Blocking Duplicate Headers and Credential Alias Bypasses

body.zh-TW: 在需要透過代理伺服器連接外部網路的環境中，這項更新替連線安全築起了更嚴格的防線。⟦猶如機場海關加強查驗流程，以前旅客報出目的地前不會先核驗護照，現在查驗官在查詢航線前就先確認出境許可，嚴查重複填寫的申報表，也不再讓換了別名的違禁證件繞過檢查站。⟧網路代理現在會在發起網域名稱查詢（將網址轉譯為伺服器位址的查詢）前，先行檢查該連線是否具備相應權限。代理伺服器也會主動拒絕帶有重複 `Host` 標頭的請求，並防止憑證別名繞過檢查掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），杜絕未經授權的潛在連線漏洞。
body.en: In environments that route external network traffic through a proxy server, this update erects a stricter line of defense for connection security. ⟦Customs inspectors at an airport checkpoint tighten screening procedures: where officers previously did not verify passports before travelers stated their destinations, inspectors now confirm exit permits before looking up flight routes, strictly scrutinize duplicate declaration forms, and block contraband credentials disguised under aliases from slipping past checkpoints.⟧ The network proxy now verifies whether a connection holds appropriate permissions before initiating a domain name query (resolving a web address into a server destination). The proxy server also actively rejects requests bearing duplicate `Host` headers and prevents credential aliases from bypassing check hooks (small routines triggered when specific events occur), plugging potential unauthorized connection loopholes.

items.original: The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)

title.zh-TW: Windows 支援快捷鍵貼圖，WSL 剪貼簿重複讀取並防止複製卡死
title.en: Windows Gains Image Pasting Shortcuts, While WSL Reuses Clipboard Readers and Prevents Copy Freezes

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 或 WSL（Windows 系統內建的 Linux 子系統）環境下操作終端機的讀者，剪貼內容時將順暢許多。⟦恰似換了一組靈敏的櫃檯讀卡機，兩組指定快捷鍵都能把文字與圖片直接貼進視窗；頻繁讀取時能共用讀取模組，複製操作也會逾時退出，不再一直卡住。⟧在 Windows 中，`Ctrl+V` 與 `Shift+Insert` 現在都能貼上文字與圖片。而在 WSL 環境下，連續多次貼上會重複使用剪貼簿讀取器；複製操作在遇到阻礙時則會逾時退出，不再無休止地卡死畫面。
body.en: Readers running terminals under Windows or WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) will experience far smoother clipboard workflows. ⟦Upgrading to a responsive card reader at a checkout counter allows two designated shortcuts to feed both text and images straight into the window, frequent scans share the reader module, and stalled copy operations time out instead of hanging indefinitely.⟧ On Windows, both `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` can now paste text and images. Under WSL, successive pastes reuse the clipboard reader, while copy operations encountering obstacles time out gracefully rather than freezing the screen indefinitely.

items.original: On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)

title.zh-TW: 指令輸出修復：本地與遠端傳輸更穩，codex exec 不再重複印出差異
title.en: Command Output Fixes: Steadier Local and Remote Transfers, codex exec Stops Reprinting Diffs

body.zh-TW: 經常在終端機執行本機指令或遠端遙控工作的讀者，這次更新修復了多項令指令卡住或資訊混亂的輸出問題。⟦宛如貨運物流中心整頓了出貨流程，以前只要下游包裝箱還沒封口，送貨司機就算卸完貨也只能在原地枯等，現在確認卸貨完成就能迅速出發，晚到的包裹也能妥善入庫而不被遺漏。⟧以前執行本機指令時，只要底層的子行程（由主程式衍生出來獨立處理任務的分支程式）沒有關閉輸出管道，整個指令就會乾等而不肯結束。現在本地指令在工作完成後能迅速結束。執行遠端指令時，晚到的輸出內容現在會妥善保留，確保最後一次輪詢時依然能完整收集。使用 `codex exec` 執行無關指令後，終端機也不會再重複印出先前的檔案差異清單。
body.en: For readers who regularly run local commands or remote tasks in the terminal, this update resolves several output glitches that previously hung commands or cluttered information. ⟦A freight logistics hub overhauls its shipping workflow: previously, as long as downstream packing crates remained unsealed, delivery drivers had to wait idly on site even after finishing unloading, but now drivers depart promptly once unloading is confirmed, and late-arriving parcels are safely warehoused rather than missed.⟧ Previously when running local commands, as long as underlying subprocesses (child processes spawned by the main program to handle tasks independently) kept output pipes open, the overall command would stall indefinitely rather than terminate. Local commands now exit promptly once their work is done. When executing remote commands, late-arriving output is now safely retained, ensuring it is fully collected during the final poll. Running unrelated commands via `codex exec` also no longer causes the terminal to reprint previous file diffs.

items.original:
Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
`codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

title.zh-TW: 隨附技術文件更新：收錄 GPT-6 遷移指引與 Linux 沙箱架構說明
title.en: Bundled Documentation Update: GPT-6 Migration Guide and Linux Sandbox Architecture Details

body.zh-TW: 正在規劃將專案升級至新世代模型，或關注系統底層安全防護的讀者，現在能從隨附文件中查閱更詳盡的官方指南。⟦正如工廠設備手冊換上新版擴建指南，不僅詳細列出升級新型機具時的運轉特性與資料所在地考量，也公開了安全防護罩如何隔絕危險區域並過濾高壓氣流。⟧隨附的 OpenAI 文件已更新針對 GPT-6 系列模型的遷移指引，詳細說明了各模型特定的推理特性、外部工具使用方式，以及資料駐留（資料儲存與處理的地理位置）相關考量。隨附說明也進一步釐清了 Linux 沙箱機制的運作方式，詳細介紹系統如何透過 bubblewrap 達成檔案系統隔離，並藉由 seccomp 進行系統呼叫過濾。
body.en: Readers planning to upgrade projects to next-generation models or keeping an eye on low-level system security can now consult more detailed official guidance in the bundled documentation. ⟦A factory equipment manual swaps in a fresh expansion guide, not only detailing the operational characteristics and data location considerations when upgrading to new machinery, but also revealing how safety shields isolate hazardous areas and filter high-pressure airflow.⟧ The bundled OpenAI documentation updates migration guidance for the GPT-6 model family, detailing model-specific reasoning characteristics, external tool usage, and data residency (the geographic location where data is stored and processed) considerations. The bundled documentation also clarifies how the Linux sandbox mechanism operates, detailing how the system achieves filesystem isolation through bubblewrap and filters system calls via seccomp.

items.original:
Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

title.zh-TW: 安裝包體積縮減，改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器並提示設定遷移
title.en: Package Size Reduced with Codex's Standard Shell Runner and Config Migration Notice

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 與 macOS 環境下安裝或更新 Codex 的讀者，這次會發現下載更輕盈且底層執行器更單純。⟦與出差輕裝上陣的概念相同，以前行李箱裡硬塞了一整套自備工具組，現在改用原有的標準工具，並把非必要的裝飾吊牌全數卸下，讓行李箱體積與重量減輕不少。⟧官方透過從安裝二進位檔中剝除符號（除錯用的內部名稱標籤），縮減了 Linux 與 macOS 版本的安裝套件體積，原始建置產物則依然保留完整符號。在執行架構上，Codex 現在改用 Codex 的標準 shell 執行器（負責執行命令的工具），不再隨附修補版的 `zsh`。如果既有設定仍包含已淘汰的 shell 標記，系統會跳出遷移通知協助你平順過渡。
body.en: Readers installing or updating Codex on Linux and macOS will find lighter downloads and a simpler underlying runner. ⟦A business traveler packs light under the same principle: rather than stuffing a custom toolkit into a suitcase, they rely on existing standard tools and strip away nonessential decorative tags, significantly reducing suitcase size and weight.⟧ The team reduced package sizes for Linux and macOS releases by stripping symbols (internal name labels used for debugging) from installation binaries, while raw build artifacts still retain full symbols. In terms of execution architecture, Codex now switches to Codex's standard shell runner (a tool responsible for executing commands), no longer bundling a patched `zsh`. If existing configurations still contain deprecated shell flags, the system displays a migration notice to help you transition smoothly.

items.original:
Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

title.zh-TW: 終端機顯示多行提問不再當機
title.en: Terminal Displaying Multiline Prompts No Longer Crashes

body.zh-TW: 當你在文字視窗等待背景任務，途中跳出落落長的確認提問時，畫面不會再突然卡死關閉。以前遇到非同步提問（程式在背後運作時插進來詢問意見的對話）包含多行文字，終端機文字介面常會直接當機。這個問題現在已經修好，訊息裡的換行排版會原樣保留，附帶的超連結完整網址也不會遺失。以前常因為介面當機而看不到完整問題，現在長內容與跳轉連結都能順利讀取。
body.en: When you wait for background tasks in a text window and a lengthy confirmation prompt pops up along the way, the screen will no longer suddenly freeze and close. Previously, when asynchronous prompts (dialogues that interrupt to ask for input while programs run in the background) contained multiline text, the terminal text interface often crashed directly. This issue is now fixed, with line breaks in messages preserved as formatted and full URLs in attached hyperlinks no longer lost. While users previously often missed full questions due to interface crashes, long content and redirect links can now be read smoothly.

items.original: Fixed a TUI crash when asynchronous questions contain multiple lines, preserving line breaks and complete hyperlink destinations. (#51866)

title.zh-TW: 命令列啟動不再因背景伺服器設定不同而失敗
title.en: Command-Line Startup No Longer Fails Over Differing Background Server Settings

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓工具在背後持續運作，開新視窗輸入指令時，不必再擔心程式卡在開頭進不去。以前只要正在執行的背景伺服器與命令列介面（CLI，用文字指令操作的工具）預設設定不同，啟動就會報錯失敗。現在相容性檢查只會在命令列明確覆寫功能時才進行，啟動失敗的問題已經修好。以前常因預設值不同而被擋在門外，現在就算背景設定有別也能順利開啟。
body.en: If you are used to letting tools run continuously in the background, you no longer need to worry about programs getting stuck at startup when entering commands in a new window. Previously, whenever the running background server and the command-line interface (tools operated with text commands) had different default settings, startup would fail with an error. Now, compatibility checks only run when the command line explicitly overrides features, and the startup failure issue has been fixed. While users were previously locked out due to differing default values, the tool can now launch smoothly even when background configurations differ.

items.original: Fixed startup failures caused by differences between a running background server's feature settings and CLI defaults. Compatibility checks now apply only to explicit command-line feature overrides. (#52648)

title.zh-TW: 支援管理 Git 工作樹，平行開發多分支
title.en: Support for Managing Git Worktrees to Develop Multiple Branches in Parallel

body.zh-TW: 當你想在同一個專案同時開發不同功能，又不想頻繁切換分支打斷進度時，現在可以在受信任的本機專案中使用專屬工具。只要開啟工作樹功能，AI 就能直接建立並列出託管的 Git 工作樹（worktree，讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）。⟦好比在圖畫紙旁多鋪一張描圖紙，以前想畫草稿必須擦掉原本的線條，現在能同時畫兩張草圖而且隨時對照。⟧
body.en: When you want to develop different features in the same project simultaneously without interrupting progress by frequently switching branches, dedicated tools are now available in trusted local projects. Once the worktree feature is enabled, the AI can directly create and list managed Git worktrees (parallel copies of the same project managed by Git). ⟦Picture laying an extra sheet of tracing paper beside your drawing paper: whereas sketching a new idea previously meant erasing original lines, you can now work on two drafts simultaneously and cross-reference them at any time.⟧

items.original: Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)

title.zh-TW: 按鍵釘選重要任務，集中在置頂群組
title.en: Pin Important Tasks via Keystroke to Group Them at the Top

body.zh-TW: 當你在代理人的命令中心同時追蹤好幾個任務，想把當前最重要的項目固定在顯眼處時，現在只要按下鍵盤上的 p 鍵就能快速釘選。只要伺服器支援這項功能，被釘選的任務就會統一歸入共用的 Pinned 群組中，方便你隨時回頭檢視這些項目的處理進度。⟦像在辦公白板上貼便利貼，以前待辦項目一多很容易被新任務洗下去，現在能把要緊的事釘在最上方的專用區域，一眼就能看清。⟧
body.en: When tracking multiple tasks simultaneously in the agent command center and looking to keep the most critical items prominent, you can now press the p key on your keyboard to pin them quickly. As long as the server supports this capability, pinned tasks are consolidated into a shared Pinned group, making it easy to review their progress at any time. ⟦Like placing sticky notes on an office whiteboard, where a growing list of to-dos once got buried under incoming tasks, you can now pin pressing items to a dedicated top section for immediate visibility.⟧

items.original: Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面複製更靈活，滾輪速度隨意調
title.en: Flexible Terminal UI Copying and Adjustable Scroll Speed

body.zh-TW: 在終端介面翻看長篇對話時，如果你想快速抓出某段程式碼或重點回覆，現在的操作方式更加順手。你可以直接輸入 /copy 來選取並複製對話紀錄區塊，或是按下 Ctrl+Insert 複製目前滑鼠反白的文字。如果覺得終端介面捲動太快或太慢，還可以在設定中加入 tui.mouse_scroll_speed 調整滑鼠滾輪的捲動速度。⟦彷彿看長篇電子書時換了順手的翻頁器，以前選字複製經常受限於視窗操作，現在能精準抓取段落還能微調捲動步調。⟧
body.en: When browsing long conversations in the terminal UI, extracting specific code snippets or key responses is now much smoother. You can enter /copy to select and copy conversation blocks, or press Ctrl+Insert to copy text currently highlighted by the mouse. If the terminal UI scrolls too fast or too slow, you can also add tui.mouse_scroll_speed in the settings to adjust the mouse wheel scroll speed. ⟦Think of switching to a handy page-turner while reading a long e-book, where selecting and copying text was once constrained by window interactions, but you can now capture exact passages and fine-tune your scrolling pace.⟧

items.original: Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)

title.zh-TW: 終端各類提示網址皆可點，跨行連結不中斷
title.en: Clickable Terminal Prompt URLs with Unbroken Multi-Line Links

body.zh-TW: 當 AI 在終端機跳出確認提問或警告訊息並附上參考網址時，你現在不必再手動反白複製。不論網址出現在確認標頭、提問清單、警告橫幅、驗證提示，還是 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）提示中，都能直接點擊開啟。就算網址太長被終端機自動折到下一行，連結依然能完整點開而不會斷成兩截。⟦好似在紙本書的註腳旁附上完整 QR 碼，以前長網址印成兩行容易抄錯，現在直接掃描就能連到正確網頁。⟧
body.en: When the AI displays confirmation questions or warning messages in the terminal with reference URLs, you no longer need to manually highlight and copy them. Whether a URL appears in a confirmation header, question list, warning banner, verification prompt, or an MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol that connects AI to external tools) prompt, you can click to open it directly. Even if a URL is long and wrapped to the next line by the terminal, the link still opens completely without breaking in two. ⟦A printed book includes a complete QR code next to its footnotes: whereas long URLs split across two lines were once prone to copying errors, scanning directly now opens the exact page.⟧

items.original: Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)

title.zh-TW: 自訂模型支援聯網搜尋，可開啟遠端壓縮
title.en: Custom Models Gain Web Access and Remote Compaction Support

body.zh-TW: 如果你串接了相容於 Responses 介面的自訂模型供應商，現在能替它們啟用更多進階能力。你可以直接為這些自訂模型設定即時聯網功能（live web access），讓模型取得最新網路資訊。還可設定遠端壓縮能力（remote compaction），讓對話內容的濃縮由遠端處理。⟦如同替外聘的專家助理配置即時百科與秘書，你可以替他配上查詢新資料的工具，也可以安排秘書協助濃縮紀錄。⟧
body.en: If you connect custom model providers compatible with the Responses API, you can now enable more advanced capabilities for them. You can configure live web access directly for these custom models so they can retrieve the latest web information. You can also configure remote compaction so that conversation summaries are processed remotely. ⟦Equipping an external expert assistant with an updated encyclopedia and a secretary allows you to provide tools for looking up fresh data while also assigning a secretary to condense conversation logs.⟧

items.original: Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)

title.zh-TW: JavaScript 支援非同步串流，程式模式工具可排序
title.en: JavaScript Async Streaming Support and Ranked Tools in Code Mode

body.zh-TW: 在撰寫自動化腳本或使用程式模式（Code Mode）處理大量工具時，開發體驗得到了進一步強化。這次新增了 JavaScript 輔助工具，能在多個非同步操作（Promise）各自完成時立即串流回傳結果，不必苦等全部做完才一次收到。此外在 Code Mode 中，你還可以主動啟用排序工具搜尋功能，讓系統依照關聯度推薦最合適的工具。⟦跟外送點餐即時收到每道菜出餐通知一樣，以前得等整桌菜炒完才送上來，現在哪道先好就能先拿到並更快找到餐具。⟧
body.en: When writing automation scripts or handling numerous tools in Code Mode, the development experience is further enhanced. New JavaScript helper utilities now stream results back immediately as multiple asynchronous operations (Promise instances) complete individually, without waiting for every task to finish. Furthermore, in Code Mode, you can actively enable ranked tool search so the system recommends the most relevant tools by relevance. ⟦Food delivery orders send real-time alerts as each dish leaves the kitchen: instead of waiting for the entire table of dishes to be cooked before serving, you receive each item as it is ready and locate utensils much faster.⟧

items.original: Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

title.zh-TW: 終端對話遵循預設模型，保留手動指定參數
title.en: Terminal Sessions Follow Default Models While Preserving Manual Overrides

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的終端對話時，系統現在會優先採用伺服器端設定的模型與推理摘要預設值。以前新建對話可能忽略伺服器給定的預設配置，現在系統會完整遵循這些預設選項。假使你在啟動時手動傳入了特定參數，系統也會優先保留你明確指定的覆寫值，不會被預設設定強行蓋過。⟦宛若走進連鎖餐廳用餐，以前廚房常搞錯標準配方，現在預設會照標準菜單出餐，但也依然遵循你點單時註明的客製需求。⟧
body.en: When starting a new terminal conversation, the system now prioritizes server-configured defaults for models and reasoning summaries. Whereas creating a new conversation previously could ignore default server settings, the system now adheres fully to these defaults. If you manually pass specific parameters at launch, the system also prioritizes and retains your explicit override values instead of overwriting them with defaults. ⟦Dining at a chain restaurant illustrates the change: while the kitchen previously could mix up standard recipes, it now serves according to the standard menu by default while still honoring any custom preferences specified on your order.⟧

items.original: Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)

title.zh-TW: 套用補丁保留換行格式，Windows 檔案不跑版
title.en: Patch Application Preserves Line Endings Without Corrupting Windows Files

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 環境下修補程式碼時，你不再需要特地手動指定設定來維持原本的換行格式。以前執行 apply_patch 更新檔案時，若未額外開啟選項，既有的 CRLF（Windows 標準換行符號）可能會被改掉；現在 apply_patch 會自動保留檔案原有的換行格式。這個問題已經修好，能避免檔案送出版控時多出整份換行差異。⟦跟維護舊文件一樣，以前每次送出修訂都得額外勾選保留原本排版，否則換行符號會被洗掉；現在直接套用也能原樣留存。⟧
body.en: When patching code in Windows environments, you no longer need to manually specify settings to preserve original line endings. Previously, updating files with apply_patch could alter existing CRLF line endings (the standard Windows line-ending format) unless an extra option was enabled; apply_patch now automatically preserves the file's original line endings. This issue is resolved, preventing unintended diffs across the entire file when committing changes to version control. ⟦Maintaining legacy documents once required ticking an extra box on every revision to keep original formatting from getting overwritten, but applying edits now preserves line endings automatically.⟧

items.original: Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)

title.zh-TW: Linux 沙箱啟動防護強化，嚴格落實檔案隔離
title.en: Enhanced Linux Sandbox Startup Protections and Enforced File Isolation

body.zh-TW: 在 Linux 環境中使用安全沙箱隔離執行環境時，系統修復了多項攸關啟動與檔案存取的安全限制。當設定了多個禁止存取的檔案時，沙箱以前可能無法順利啟動，現在啟動流程已修復。沙箱現在會拒絕可被寫入的建構執行檔。也修正了 ripgrep 設定，確保搜尋配置不會削弱禁止規則（deny-glob）的檔案遮罩防護。⟦就像保險庫修好了門禁名單一多就卡住的問題，也拒用能被改動的門禁安裝工具，並讓查找物品的設定不會削弱禁止存取的名單。⟧
body.en: When using the security sandbox to isolate execution environments on Linux, the system fixed several security constraints related to startup and file access. The sandbox previously could fail to start when multiple denied files were configured, but this startup process is now fixed. Sandboxes now reject writable executables used to construct the sandbox. The ripgrep configuration was also corrected to ensure search settings do not weaken deny-glob file mask protections. ⟦A bank vault fixes a stall that occurred whenever access denial lists grew too long, rejects modifiable installation tools, and ensures search settings never undermine restricted lists.⟧

items.original: Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)

title.zh-TW: Windows 10 磁碟存取恢復，沙箱暫存權限一致
title.en: Restored Windows 10 Drive Access and Consistent Sandbox Temp Permissions

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 Windows 10 系統上執行指令或使用沙箱隔離環境，先前遇到的路徑找不到與權限錯誤已獲得修復。現在恢復了一般磁碟代號（如常見的 C 槽與 D 槽）檔案存取能力，讀寫既有檔案不再出錯。Windows 沙箱內的暫存目錄權限也調整為與子行程（subprocess，由主程式啟動的附屬運作程序）環境一致，避免程式在執行時因權限不符而卡住。⟦有如拿到了相符的門禁卡，以前在 Windows 10 容易讀不到磁碟或被暫存目錄擋在門外，現在權限一致後各項操作都能順利通行。⟧
body.en: If you run commands or use sandboxed environments on Windows 10, previously encountered missing path and permission errors are now resolved. Standard drive letter file access (such as common C: and D: drives) is restored, preventing errors when reading or writing existing files. Permissions for temporary directories inside the Windows sandbox are also aligned with environments of subprocesses (child processes started by the main program), preventing programs from hanging due to permission mismatches during execution. ⟦Obtaining a matching keycard resolves previous hurdles on Windows 10 where drives were unreadable or temp directories locked you out, ensuring all operations proceed smoothly with consistent permissions.⟧

items.original: Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)

title.zh-TW: 遵循伺服器建議時間重試
title.en: Retrying Requests Following Server Recommendations

body.zh-TW: 使用 Codex 時，送出的請求或即時連線若失敗，你可能需要等一段時間才能重試。Responses（傳送模型請求的介面）的可重試失敗，現在會遵循伺服器的 Retry-After 建議。這個標頭會告訴用戶端應等待多久再試。WebSocket（維持雙向即時通訊的連線）的可重試失敗也適用：依照建議時間等待後再重試。⟦好比撥打客服電話遇到忙線，聽到語音建議稍後再撥，就依照建議等候，再重新撥打。⟧
body.en: When using Codex, if a sent request or real-time connection fails, you may need to wait for a while before retrying. Retryable failures for Responses (the interface for sending model requests) now follow the server's Retry-After recommendation. This header tells the client how long to wait before trying again. Retryable failures for WebSocket connections (which maintain two-way, real-time communication) also follow this rule by waiting for the suggested duration before retrying. ⟦When dialing a busy customer service line, a caller follows the automated voice prompt to wait for the suggested time before calling back.⟧

items.original: Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)

title.zh-TW: Windows 安裝程式附帶數位簽章，版本下載更安全
title.en: Windows Installers Include Digital Signatures for Safer Version Downloads

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 下安裝或更新系統時，安裝腳本與版本下載機制現在具備更高的安全性與相容性。Windows 發行版本現在附帶已簽署的 PowerShell 安裝程式。當環境中存在 PowerShell 7 模組路徑時，舊版透過 Windows PowerShell 安裝可能發生的壓縮檔校驗碼驗證失敗問題也已修好。下載管理方面，系統現在能防止舊版或預覽版本意外覆蓋較新的穩定版下載目標與安裝別名。⟦猶如官方包裹附上可核對來源的簽名，以前可能誤把舊包裹拿來替換新品，現在不會了。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating the system on Windows, installer scripts and version download mechanisms now offer higher security and compatibility. Windows releases now include a signed PowerShell installer. When PowerShell 7 module paths exist in the environment, archive checksum verification failures that previously occurred when installing through Windows PowerShell are now fixed. For download management, the system now prevents older or preview versions from accidentally overwriting newer stable download targets and installation aliases. ⟦Receiving an official package with a verifiable signature ensures that old parcels are no longer mistakenly used to replace brand-new items.⟧

items.original:
Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)
Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

title.zh-TW: 分頁標題即時回報進度，不用切回終端機看狀態
title.en: Tab titles report progress in real time without switching back to the terminal

body.zh-TW:
把終端機縮到背景讓耗時任務自己跑時，我們往往得三不五時切回視窗，確認它到底跑完了沒。⟦走在辦公大樓看電梯燈號，以前得特地走到門前貼著聽聲音才確定動了沒，現在瞄一眼門楣就知道它正在移動、抵達還是卡住。⟧只要你使用的終端機支援 OSC 7501 協定，視窗或分頁標籤就會直接顯示 CLI 正在運作、等待輸入、已完成還是失敗。程式啟動時會先自動偵測終端機是否支援，不支援的軟體不會受到任何干擾。如果想微調顯示方式，可以透過環境變數管理：

```bash
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off # 關閉狀態回報
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on # 在支援卻未主動回應偵測的終端機上強制開啟
AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief # 只顯示狀態，不顯示等待執行的指令或問題細節
```
body.en:
When minimizing a terminal to run a long-running task in the background, we often have to switch windows repeatedly just to check if it is finished. ⟦Picture glancing at an elevator indicator in an office building: you once had to walk up to the door and listen closely to confirm movement, but now a glance above the door reveals whether it is running, arriving, or stuck.⟧ As long as your terminal supports the OSC 7501 protocol, window or tab titles will directly display whether the CLI is working, waiting for input, completed, or failed. The CLI automatically detects terminal support on startup, so unsupported software remains completely unaffected. If you want to tweak how details are shown, you can manage it with environment variables:

```bash
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off # Disable status reporting
AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on # Force enable on terminals that support it but do not actively respond to detection
AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief # Show only the status, omitting pending commands or prompt details
```

items.original: Added terminal status reporting over OSC 7501: in terminals that support it, the tab or window shows whether the CLI is working, waiting for your input, done, or failed. The CLI checks for support first, so other terminals are unaffected. Set `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=off` to turn it off, `AGY_CLI_OSC7501=on` for a terminal that supports it but doesn't answer the check, or `AGY_CLI_OSC7501_MESSAGES=brief` to show only the status without details such as the pending command or question.

title.zh-TW: 快捷鍵反轉送出模式，臨時插單或排隊免改設定
title.en: Shortcut inverts send mode to bypass queues or jump ahead without changing settings

body.zh-TW: 打好一段訊息準備送出時，如果目前的發送模式正好與當下需求相反，過去總得大費周章進設定選單切換。⟦跟操作辦公室的印表機一樣，以前預設好排程列印就只能乖乖排隊，現在只要按住切換鍵，就能臨時插單立刻印出，也能隨時把即時文件收進佇列。⟧新增的 `alt+m` 快捷鍵，能依據你在 `/config` 裡設定的訊息排隊模式（Queued Messages）反向發送。在 macOS 上若將 Option 鍵設為 Alt，對應的按鍵組合是 `Option+m`。如果你平時處於排隊模式（Queue），按下這組快捷鍵就會立刻送出眼前這則訊息。反過來說，若平時處於即時發送模式（Send Immediately），這組按鍵則會幫你把訊息存進排程佇列。
body.en: When typing a message and preparing to send it, finding that the current mode opposes what you need previously required a tedious trip through the settings menu. ⟦Think of using an office printer: where a scheduled print preset once forced you to wait in line, holding a toggle key now lets you jump ahead for an immediate print or route an urgent document into the queue at any time.⟧ The new `alt+m` shortcut inverts sending behavior based on the Queued Messages mode configured in `/config`. On macOS, if the Option key is mapped to Alt, the corresponding combination is `Option+m`. If you are normally in Queue mode, pressing this shortcut sends the current message immediately. Conversely, if you are normally in Send Immediately mode, this key combination saves your message into the scheduled queue.

items.original: Added the `alt+m` shortcut (`Option+m` on macOS when Option is set to act as Alt) to send a message using the opposite of your `Queued Messages` setting in `/config`, so you can send right away while in `Queue` mode, or queue a message while in `Send Immediately` mode.

title.zh-TW: 外掛驗證規則對齊執行環境，行號與格式錯誤一目了然
title.en: Plugin validation rules align with runtime, making line numbers and format errors clear

body.zh-TW: 開發外掛時最怕驗證工具回報合格，實際載入執行時卻因為隱蔽問題而無法啟動。⟦拿稿件去印刷廠打樣，以前簡易校對常誤判合格格式、又漏看致命排版問題，現在校對標準完全對齊正式印刷機台，哪個檔案第幾行出錯都會清楚標出。⟧驗證指令 `agy plugin validate` 現在改用與執行環境完全相同的規則來檢查外掛。過去簡化的檢查會誤擋未填 `name` 欄位的合格清單，卻又漏掉阻礙外掛載入的真正問題。現在檢查工具會精確標示每個錯誤與警告所在的檔案與行號，且同時接受外掛目錄或個別 `plugin.json` 檔案。工具還會提示 `plugin.json` 的常見錯誤，像是未知欄位與猜測建議、無效名稱，或組件誤置於 `.antigravity-plugin/` 而非根目錄。另外可搭配 `--strict` 讓警告一律算失敗，或使用 `--json` 在自動化建置中輸出報告。
body.en: When developing plugins, nothing is worse than a validation tool reporting success only for hidden problems to block execution at runtime. ⟦A draft sent to a print shop for proofing once suffered from simplified checks that misjudged valid formats while missing fatal layout flaws, but proofs now align entirely with production presses to clearly mark which file and line contain errors.⟧ The validation command `agy plugin validate` now checks plugins using the exact same rules as the runtime environment. In the past, simplified checks falsely blocked valid manifests missing a `name` field while overlooking real issues that prevented plugins from loading. The validation tool now pinpoints the exact file and line number for every error and warning, accepting either plugin directories or individual `plugin.json` files. It also flags common `plugin.json` mistakes, such as unknown fields with suggested fixes, invalid names, or components mistakenly placed in `.antigravity-plugin/` instead of the root directory. Additionally, you can pair it with `--strict` to treat warnings as failures, or use `--json` to output reports in automated builds.

items.original: Improved `agy plugin validate` so it checks a plugin with the same rules the CLI uses to load it, instead of simplified checks that rejected valid plugins (such as a manifest without a `name`) and missed problems that kept a plugin from loading. It lists each error and warning with its file and line, accepts a plugin directory or its `plugin.json`, warns about common `plugin.json` mistakes such as unknown fields (with "did you mean" suggestions), invalid names, and components placed inside `.antigravity-plugin/` instead of the plugin root, and adds `--strict` to fail on warnings and `--json` for a machine-readable report in CI.

title.zh-TW: 啟動驗證暫時斷線會自動重試，不再鎖死工作階段
title.en: Startup eligibility checks retry on transient errors without locking the session

body.zh-TW: 在網路偶爾斷線或啟動時剛好撞上限流的時刻，終端機若突然整台卡住、拒收訊息，往往讓人不知所措。以前只要啟動時服務短暫連不上或達到速率限制，終端機就會持續跳出 `Eligibility check failed` 錯誤並拒絕每則訊息，非得重開程式不可。現在這項資格檢查遇到暫時性錯誤時會自動重試，不再鎖死整個工作階段，這個問題已經修好，連線恢復後就能直接繼續對話。
body.en: When the network drops intermittently or startup runs into rate limits, having the entire terminal freeze and reject input is disorienting. Previously, if the service became briefly unreachable or hit a rate limit at launch, the terminal repeatedly threw `Eligibility check failed` errors and rejected every message, leaving you no choice but to restart the application. This eligibility check now automatically retries on transient errors instead of locking up the entire session. This issue has been fixed, allowing you to resume your conversation as soon as connectivity recovers.

items.original: Fixed the CLI refusing every message with `Eligibility check failed` until you restarted it when the service was briefly unavailable or rate-limited at launch; the check now retries temporary errors and no longer locks the session.

title.zh-TW: 外掛 MCP 標頭支援變數替換，權杖驗證不再傳送字面占位符
title.en: Plugin MCP headers support variable substitution, preventing token authentication from sending literal placeholders

body.zh-TW: 替外掛串接需要身分驗證的自訂服務時，最怕設定好的金鑰變數沒有被正確代入。外掛中的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器如果在請求標頭使用了變數，例如 `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`，以前會直接送出原始占位符而驗證失敗。現在標頭能像伺服器的指令、參數與環境變數一樣，正確代入你設定的數值，驗證失敗的問題已經修好。
body.en: When connecting a plugin to a custom service that requires authentication, nothing is worse than having configured secret variables fail to substitute properly. If an MCP (a protocol connecting AI to external tools) server in a plugin used variables in request headers, such as `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`, it previously sent the raw placeholder directly and failed authentication. Headers now properly substitute your configured values just like server commands, arguments, and environment variables, fixing the authentication failure.

items.original: Fixed plugin MCP servers that use a variable in a request header, such as `"Authorization": "Bearer ${TOKEN}"`, sending the literal placeholder and failing to authenticate; headers now get the value you configured, like the server's command, arguments, and environment already did.

title.zh-TW: 差異比較畫面填滿終端機，支援瀏覽百筆提交紀錄
title.en: Diff view fills terminal height and supports browsing up to a hundred commits

body.zh-TW: 想回顧專案最近的修改歷程時，在終端機裡瀏覽歷史版本往往受限於視野與操作順暢度。在 `/diff` 的提交樹（Commit Tree）檢視畫面中，以前頂端只會計算行數，而且最多只能看到最近 10 筆紀錄。現在整個畫面會自動填滿終端機高度，並支援捲動瀏覽最近 100 筆提交紀錄。頂端標題改為正確顯示提交筆數，游標也只會在提交列停留，只要按下 `Enter` 就能直接開啟該筆內容。
body.en: When reviewing recent project revisions, browsing commit history inside a terminal is often constrained by viewport limits and navigation friction. In the `/diff` commit tree view, the header previously only counted lines and capped visibility at the 10 most recent commits. The view now expands to fill the full terminal height and supports scrolling through the 100 most recent commits. The top header now correctly displays the commit count, the cursor only stops on commit rows, and pressing `Enter` directly opens the selected entry.

items.original: Fixed the `/diff` Commit Tree view: the header now counts commits instead of lines, the cursor stops only on commit rows and `Enter` opens that commit, the view fills the terminal height, and it shows the latest 100 commits (previously 10) with scrolling.

title.zh-TW: 背景指令狀態不再回溯，完整保留工作進度與日誌
title.en: Background command state no longer rolls back, keeping work progress and logs intact

body.zh-TW:
讓 AI 助理在背景執行耗時指令的同時，如果你繼續在前景修改程式碼，現在兩邊的進度都不會再莫名遺失。

以前只要背景指令執行完畢，若助理仍在持續工作，手邊剛修改的檔案、任務清單與工作階段花費就會全部遺失，甚至倒退回該指令剛啟動時的狀態。現在狀態回溯問題已經修好，背景任務結束時會妥善保留所有前景進度。

背景指令的任務日誌過去有時會漏掉最後幾行輸出。現在無論指令是正常完成還是中途被取消，最終輸出內容都會完整寫入日誌中。⟦如同把大批文件交給影印機後轉頭批閱公文，以前影印結束時，剛批好的文件會莫名倒退回未批狀態，現在影印和手邊進度都能各自完整保留。⟧
body.en:
When having the AI assistant run time-consuming commands in the background while you continue editing code in the foreground, progress on both sides is no longer mysteriously lost.

Previously, once a background command finished, if the assistant was still actively working, your recent file edits, task lists, and session spend were entirely lost, even rolling back to the state when that command first started. This state regression issue is now fixed, cleanly preserving all foreground progress when background tasks complete.

Task logs for background commands also previously missed the last few lines of output at times. Whether a command finishes normally or is canceled midway through, the final output is now fully written into the log. ⟦Consider handing a large stack of documents to a copier while reviewing paperwork at your desk: previously, finishing the copy job mysteriously reverted freshly reviewed papers to an unreviewed state, but copying and foreground work are now preserved completely.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the agent losing track of its file changes, tasks, and session cost when a background command finished while the agent kept working; they no longer roll back to the point where that command started.
Fixed a background command's final output sometimes missing from its task log; the output is now always recorded when the command finishes or is canceled.

title.zh-TW: 回覆中的資料夾連結恢復顯示，不再留下一片空白
title.en: Folder links in responses reappear, leaving no blank gaps

body.zh-TW: 看著 AI 助理在回答中推薦某個專案目錄時，如果路徑文字整段消失，往往讓人摸不著頭緒。以前助理的回覆如果包含指向資料夾的連結，該連結文字有時會從畫面上消失，讓整段說明缺字斷句。現在這個問題已經修好，回答會正常顯示出資料夾名稱，例如 `pipelines/`，讓你一眼看清路徑位置。
body.en: When reading an AI assistant response that recommends a project directory, having the path text vanish entirely is confusing. Previously, if the assistant response contained a link pointing to a folder, the link text occasionally disappeared from the screen, leaving broken sentences with missing words. This issue is now fixed, and responses display folder names normally, such as `pipelines/`, allowing you to see path locations at a glance.

items.original: Fixed links to directories disappearing from agent responses; they now show the directory name, for example `pipelines/`.

title.zh-TW: 支援雲端憑證登入 Claude 5.5，權限符合才列出模型
title.en: Support Cloud Credential Login for Claude 5.5 and List Models Only When Permissions Match

body.zh-TW: 如果你平時依賴 Google Cloud 的應用程式預設憑證登入工具，現在環境變數 `AGY_ADC_AUTH` 已經正式支援 Claude Opus 5.5 與 Claude Sonnet 5.5 兩款模型。只要在終端機打 `/model` 切換模型，選單就不會再把所有選項一口氣倒給你，而是會先檢查你的 Google Cloud 專案權限。⟦跟持識別證走進大型研發園區一樣，以前不管個人資格有沒有開通，預約看板都會列出所有設備，等登記時才碰壁；現在看板會先核對專案清單，只有你真正能啟用的實驗室才會亮起。⟧當你正在處理需要高強度推理的系統架構，想切換到更合適的模型時，只要打 `/model`，就能直接確認目前專案是否獲准調用這兩款 Claude 5.5 模型。這避免了你選取模型後送出請求，才因為專案缺少權限而中途失敗。
body.en: If you rely on Google Cloud Application Default Credentials to sign in to the tool, the `AGY_ADC_AUTH` environment variable now officially supports Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5. Whenever you type `/model` in the terminal to switch models, the menu no longer dumps every option onto you at once, but first checks your Google Cloud project permissions. ⟦Think of walking into a large research campus with an access badge: previously, the booking board listed every facility regardless of whether your credentials had been granted, leaving you stuck at check-in; now, the board checks your project list first, lighting up only the labs you can actually activate.⟧ When you are working on a system architecture that requires intensive reasoning and want to switch to a more suitable model, typing `/model` lets you directly verify whether the current project is authorized to call these two Claude 5.5 models. This prevents you from selecting a model and sending a request, only to have it fail midway due to missing project permissions.

items.original: Added Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Sonnet 5.5 for Application Default Credentials (`AGY_ADC_AUTH`) sign-in. Claude models now appear in `/model` only if your Google Cloud project can use them.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式審查提速，放行程式碼整理並攔截敏感資料
title.en: Accelerate Auto Mode Reviews to Allow Code Cleanup and Block Sensitive Data

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟自動模式讓工具自行修改專案時，只要指令需要跨出終端機沙盒（隔離執行指令的受保護環境），現在審查流程變得更快而且不再無故逾時。⟦就像貨運物流中心的智慧安檢線，以前每件包裹都要等主管蓋章甚至拖到下班逾期，現在例行整理作業直接放行，但只要測出夾帶未授權的危險物品就立刻攔截。⟧對於專案工作區自帶的程式碼格式化、檢查與自動修復指令，審查機制會直接判斷安全並放行，不會再三停下來跳出提示打擾你。相對地，要是指令試圖將專案裡的敏感資料上傳到外部，工具會第一時間阻擋該動作，保護你的隱私與憑證安全。
body.en: When you enable auto mode to let the tool modify your project, any command that needs to step outside the terminal sandbox (a protected environment for isolated command execution) now undergoes a faster review process that no longer times out for no reason. ⟦Picture a smart security checkpoint at a freight logistics center: previously, every package had to wait for a supervisor's stamp or even timed out past closing; now, routine sorting operations pass straight through, while unauthorized hazardous goods are immediately intercepted upon detection.⟧ For built-in code formatting, linting, and autofix commands in your project workspace, the review mechanism directly determines they are safe and allows them through without repeatedly pausing to prompt you. Conversely, if a command attempts to upload sensitive project data externally, the tool immediately blocks the action to protect your privacy and credentials.

items.original: Improved Auto mode's review of commands that would leave the terminal sandbox: the review is faster and no longer times out without a decision, it allows the workspace's own format, lint, and fix commands instead of asking about them, and it blocks commands that would upload sensitive data.

title.zh-TW: 提交樹視覺配色翻新，版本雜湊與修改說明層次分明
title.en: Refresh Visual Color Scheme for Commit Tree with Clear Hierarchy for Hashes and Descriptions

body.zh-TW: 每次打 `/diff` 檢視版本提交樹時，你不再需要在一片灰白的純文字裡吃力尋找剛改動的內容。⟦好比查對加註色彩的財務對帳單，以前所有數字與明細全擠成一團難以分辨，現在交易編號清晰標亮、說明備註淡化處理，尚未結清的最新項目也格外醒目。⟧畫面上提交紀錄的雜湊值（commit hash，Git 用來標記特定版本的一串代碼）與變更識別碼現在都有高亮色彩，讓每個版本節點一目了然。相對地，次要的提交說明文字則調暗顯示，代表當前位置的 `@` 符號加粗呈現，未提交的工作複本（Working Copy）一整列更是清晰凸顯，讓版本代碼、時間戳記與說明文字徹底分開，不再黏成難以閱讀的文字區塊。
body.en: Whenever you type `/diff` to inspect the commit tree, you no longer need to struggle through monochrome plain text to locate your recent changes. ⟦A color-coded financial statement illustrates the change: previously, every figure and line item blurred together in an indistinguishable block; now, transaction numbers are brightly highlighted, descriptive notes are dimmed, and unsettled recent entries stand out prominently.⟧ Commit hashes and change identifiers across the display now feature highlighted colors, making each revision node immediately clear at a glance. In contrast, secondary commit descriptions are dimmed, the `@` symbol representing your current position is bolded, and the entire row for an uncommitted working copy is sharply accented, cleanly separating revision codes, timestamps, and descriptive text so they no longer blur into an illegible block of text.

items.original: Improved the `/diff` Commit Tree view with colors: commit hashes and change IDs are highlighted, descriptions are dimmed, the `Working Copy (Uncommitted Changes)` row stands out, and `@` is bold, so hashes, timestamps, and descriptions no longer run together.

title.zh-TW: 修復代理人無故卡死，連線重試、提問互動與指令防呆到位
title.en: Fix Agent Stalls with Connection Retries, Question Interactions, and Command Safeguards

body.zh-TW: 放手讓背景代理人執行繁重任務時，你最怕它無聲無息卡在半路、永遠等不到下一步。當模型連線停滯且超過 5 分鐘沒有傳回任何資料時，請求會自動取消並重新嘗試，中斷的請求也不會再於紀錄中留下一片空白的回覆步驟。子代理人與工作流程代理人主動發問時，提問不再悄悄遺失；介面現在會明確跳出提示顯示哪個代理人有問題，按快捷鍵 `Ctrl+K` 或 `a` 就能開啟選單作答。若是使用 `-p` 參數的無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機畫面的執行模式），則會自動略過這些提問以確保流程不中斷。遇到執行版本控制指令需要文字編輯器的情況（例如沒加 `-m` 的 `git commit` 或 `jj describe`），工具會直接將編輯器環境變數設為 `false`，讓指令當場報錯失敗，避免代理人卡在看不見的背景編輯器裡乾等。
body.en: When letting a background agent handle heavy tasks, the biggest worry is having it stall midway in silence, leaving you waiting indefinitely for the next step. If the model connection stalls and returns no data for more than 5 minutes, the request is automatically canceled and retried, and interrupted requests no longer leave a blank response step in the log. When subagents or workflow agents ask questions, their inquiries are no longer quietly lost. The interface now clearly displays a prompt indicating which agent has a question, and pressing the `Ctrl+K` or `a` shortcut opens a menu to answer. When running in headless mode with the `-p` flag (an execution mode without a terminal window), these questions are automatically skipped to ensure the workflow continues uninterrupted. When a version control command requires a text editor (such as `git commit` or `jj describe` without `-m`), the tool directly sets the editor environment variable to `false`. This fails the command immediately with an error, preventing the agent from idling in an invisible background editor.

items.original:
Fixed the agent hanging indefinitely when the model connection stalled: if no data arrives for 5 minutes the request is now canceled and retried automatically, and a stalled request no longer leaves an empty response step behind.
Fixed questions asked by subagents and workflow agents being lost, which left the subagent waiting forever: the alert now reads `<agent> has a question` and shows it, and `Ctrl+K` or `a` in the subagent's view opens a question picker that sends your answer to that agent. Headless `-p` runs skip these questions so the subagent can continue.
Fixed agent shell commands hanging on an invisible editor when a version control command wants one, such as `git commit` without `-m` or `jj describe`: the CLI now sets `GIT_EDITOR`, `HGEDITOR`, and `JJ_EDITOR` to `false` for agent commands, so they fail right away instead.

title.zh-TW: 擴充設定與外掛解析修復，冒號字串與指令大小寫皆能識別
title.en: Fix Extension Settings and Plugin Parsing to Recognize Colons in Strings and Command Casing

body.zh-TW: 在擴充自訂技能或管理外部外掛程式時，設定檔裡的微小語法差異不再導致載入失敗。為自訂技能、規則、工作流程或 Markdown 代理人編寫說明時，即使在 `description:` 後方未加引號的文字中包含冒號，也能順利解析，不再跳出格式錯誤訊息而中斷載入。外掛若在根目錄的 `agents.json` 宣告了子代理人，現在執行 `agy plugin validate` 驗證、`agy plugin install` 顯示安裝摘要，或在 `/plugin` 探索分頁瀏覽市集預覽時，都會如實列出，不再遭遺漏。外掛指令與資訊清單現在不再嚴格區分英文大小寫。打 `/plugin List` 等子指令不再因大寫報錯，資訊清單檔名若取為 `Plugin.json`，在安裝、驗證以及啟用或停用時也都能正確辨識。
body.en: When extending custom skills or managing external plugins, minor syntax differences in configuration files no longer cause load failures. When writing descriptions for custom skills, rules, workflows, or Markdown agents, unquoted text following `description:` parses smoothly even if it contains a colon, rather than throwing a formatting error that aborts loading. If a plugin declares subagents in its root `agents.json`, running `agy plugin validate` to verify, running `agy plugin install` to view the installation summary, or browsing the marketplace preview on the `/plugin` Discover tab will now faithfully list them without omissions. Plugin commands and manifests are also no longer strictly case-sensitive. Typing subcommands such as `/plugin List` no longer errors out due to uppercase letters, and a manifest file named `Plugin.json` is properly recognized during installation, validation, activation, and deactivation.

items.original:
Fixed skills, rules, workflows, and Markdown agents failing to load with `mapping values are not allowed in this context` when an unquoted `description:` contains a colon, such as `description: Runs checks: formatters and linters.`
Fixed `agy plugin validate`, the summary `agy plugin install` prints, and marketplace previews in the `/plugin` Discover tab leaving out subagents a plugin declares in its root `agents.json`.
Fixed plugin names and manifests being case-sensitive where the agent was not: `/plugin` subcommands such as `/plugin List` now work in any case instead of failing with `Unknown subcommand`, and a manifest named `Plugin.json` is now found by `agy plugin install`, `agy plugin validate`, and enable and disable.

title.zh-TW: Mermaid 圖表渲染修復，註解指令與新版語法正常繪製
title.en: Fix Mermaid Diagram Rendering to Properly Draw Directives, Comments, and New Syntax

body.zh-TW: 在檢視代理人回覆或產出物檢視器的圖表時，Mermaid 圖形現在都能正常渲染呈現。以前只要圖表開頭帶有 YAML 前置資料、`%%{init: ...}%%` 指令、`%%` 註解，或是使用 Mermaid v11 節點語法（例如 `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }`），畫面就會直接印出一整段原始碼文字。現在這些語法都能正確繪製成視覺圖表。
body.en: When viewing diagrams in agent responses or the artifact viewer, Mermaid diagrams now render properly. Previously, whenever a diagram began with YAML frontmatter, a `%%{init: ...}%%` directive, `%%` comments, or used Mermaid v11 node syntax (such as `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }`), the display would simply print out a raw block of source code. Now, all such syntax renders correctly into visual diagrams.

items.original: Fixed Mermaid diagrams that start with YAML frontmatter, a `%%{init: ...}%%` directive, or `%%` comments, or that use Mermaid v11 syntax such as `id@{ shape: ..., label: ... }` nodes, showing as raw source instead of rendering in agent responses and the artifact viewer.

title.zh-TW: 多行提示詞換行順暢，檔案提及選單不再干擾按鍵
title.en: Smooth Multiline Prompt Line Breaks Without File Mention Menu Interfering with Keystrokes

body.zh-TW: 當你在輸入框寫下較長的需求、按下換行準備分段時，最怕編輯節奏莫名被打亂。以前只要在輸入內容中打出 `@` 喚起檔案下拉選單，接著換行時選單仍然會持續卡在畫面上，強行攔截你的上下方向鍵，按下 Enter 鍵更會直接誤選檔案，而不是如期插入新的一行。這個選單殘留的問題已經修好，讓你換行編輯文字時不再被按鍵劫持。
body.en: When writing longer requirements in the input box and pressing Enter to start a new paragraph, the last thing you want is having your editing rhythm disrupted. Previously, typing `@` in the input summoned the file dropdown menu, and pressing Enter to insert a line break left the menu stuck on screen. It forcibly intercepted your up and down arrow keys, and pressing Enter accidentally selected a file instead of inserting a newline as expected. This menu persistence issue has been fixed so that line-breaking and editing text are no longer hijacked by keystrokes.

items.original: Fixed the `@` file-mention dropdown staying open after a newline in a multi-line prompt, where it took over `Up`/`Down` and made `Enter` pick a file instead of inserting the newline.

title.zh-TW: 檢視器搜尋定位修復，特殊字母不再錯位或當機
title.en: Fix Viewer Search Positioning to Prevent Misalignment and Crashes on Special Characters

body.zh-TW: 在檔案與產出物檢視器中按 `/` 搜尋內文時，遇到特殊字母現在能精確標亮目標。以前若行內包含轉成小寫後字元長度會改變的字母（例如土耳其語的大寫「İ」），搜尋時高亮標記會對錯字元甚至引發當機，使用 `n` 與 `N` 跳轉時也常常停在根本沒有亮起的行。現在字元對應錯誤已修好，按 `n` 與 `N` 切換時也只會停在真正帶有高亮的行上。
body.en: When pressing `/` to search file contents in the file and artifact viewers, the target is now accurately highlighted even when encountering special characters. Previously, if a line contained characters whose length changed upon lowercasing (such as the Turkish capital "İ"), search highlighting would misalign with characters or even trigger a crash. Navigating with `n` and `N` often stopped on lines that were not highlighted at all. Character mapping errors are now resolved, and cycling with `n` and `N` lands only on lines that actually contain highlights.

items.original: Fixed `/` search in the file and artifact viewer highlighting the wrong characters, or crashing, on lines with letters whose lowercase form has a different length such as `İ`; `n` and `N` now stop only on lines that show a highlight.

title.zh-TW: 程式碼搜尋支援中文長路徑，斷行不再切碎字元變亂碼
title.en: Support Long Chinese Paths in Code Search to Prevent Truncating Multibyte Characters into Mojibake

body.zh-TW: 在專案中執行 `/codesearch` 查找程式碼時，搜尋結果包含多位元組文字現在排版更為俐落。以前只要程式碼長行或檔案路徑含有 CJK（中日韓統一表意文字）等字元，在終端機寬度限制下截斷時，字元位元組常會被切碎，導致結尾顯示出亂碼符號「」。現在遇到長行與路徑都會在安全邊界乾淨加上省略號，不再產生亂碼。
body.en: When running `/codesearch` to look up code across a project, search results containing multibyte text are now laid out much more cleanly. Previously, whenever long lines of code or file paths contained characters like CJK (Chinese, Japanese, and Korean unified ideographs), truncating them at the terminal width boundary frequently shredded character bytes and produced the replacement symbol "" at the end. Now, long lines and paths are cleanly truncated with ellipses at safe boundaries, preventing mojibake.

items.original: Fixed long lines and file paths containing CJK or other multi-byte text turning into `�` characters in `/codesearch` results; they are now cut cleanly with an ellipsis.

title.zh-TW: 自動模式登場，常規修改直接放行免反覆確認
title.en: Auto Mode Arrives, Allowing Routine Changes Directly Without Repeated Confirmations

body.zh-TW: 在終端機裡請 AI 幫忙寫程式或改檔案時，每動一行代碼都要停下來等你按 Enter 同意，流程往往被打得支離破碎。⟦宛如聘請具備授權的專業秘書，平時修改筆記或整理歸檔會直接代勞，只有遇到銷毀重要資料或簽署大筆合約時才會敲門請示。⟧新加入的自動模式（auto mode，自動核准安全操作的執行模式）會自動放行檔案編輯與安全指令，但在執行不可逆操作前依然會主動提示。要是指令可能脫離終端機沙盒（限制程式執行範圍的隔離環境），還會先交由另一個獨立代理人審查。你可以輸入 `--mode auto`、在 `/config` 裡選擇 `Agent Mode`，或是按 `Shift+Tab` 鍵循環切換模式。這項功能目前已支援 Linux 與 macOS，Windows 支援則會在後續版本推出。
body.en: When asking AI to write code or edit files in the terminal, having to pause and press Enter for every single line often shatters your workflow. ⟦Picture hiring an empowered executive assistant who handles editing notes or archiving files directly, knocking on your door only to shred critical records or sign major contracts.⟧ The newly added auto mode (an execution mode that automatically approves safe operations) automatically allows file edits and safe commands, yet it still prompts before executing irreversible actions. If a command might escape the terminal sandbox (an isolated environment restricting program execution scope), an independent agent reviews it first. You can enter `--mode auto`, select `Agent Mode` in `/config`, or press `Shift+Tab` to cycle through modes. This feature is currently supported on Linux and macOS, with Windows support arriving in a future release.

items.original: Added Auto mode, which approves file edits and safe commands without asking and still prompts before irreversible actions; commands that would leave the terminal sandbox are first reviewed by a separate agent. Choose it with `--mode auto`, from `Agent Mode` in `/config`, or by pressing `Shift+Tab` to cycle modes. Auto mode is available on Linux and macOS, with Windows support coming later.

title.zh-TW: 新增 /compact 指令，隨時壓縮對話釋放記憶空間
title.en: New /compact Command Compresses Conversations Anytime to Free Up Memory

body.zh-TW: 和 AI 討論專案來回好幾輪之後，對話紀錄越積越長，往往會把模型一次能閱讀的長度塞得滿滿當當。⟦跟整理厚重的會議紀錄本一樣，以前寫到頁尾只能整本封存換新冊子，現在助理會當場把前面發言濃縮成精華摘要，空出乾淨版面讓你接著寫。⟧現在你可以隨時輸入 `/compact` 來壓縮對話並釋出脈絡視窗（context window，AI 一次能讀取與記住的最大文字範圍）。單獨執行 `/compact` 會總結目前的對話並結束這個回合。若是輸入 `/compact <message>`，它則會在完成總結後接著回答你的新問題。壓縮執行期間終端機會顯示 `Compacting conversation...` 進度標籤，按 `Esc` 鍵就能隨時取消。處理完成後還會清楚列出總共整理了多少步對話，以及脈絡縮小了多少。
body.en: After multiple rounds of project discussions with AI, accumulating conversation logs often crowd the model's reading limit to capacity. ⟦Think of organizing a bulky meeting notebook where reaching the bottom of a page once required archiving the entire binder for a fresh one, but now an assistant condenses prior discussions into a concise summary on the spot, freeing up clean pages for you to keep writing.⟧ You can now enter `/compact` at any time to compress conversations and free up the context window (the maximum range of text an AI can read and retain at once). Running `/compact` by itself summarizes the current conversation and ends the turn. If you enter `/compact <message>`, it answers your new question right after finishing the summary. During compression, the terminal displays a `Compacting conversation...` progress indicator, and pressing `Esc` cancels at any time. Once finished, it clearly lists the total number of dialogue steps organized and how much context was reduced.

items.original: Added the `/compact` command to compact the conversation on demand and free up the context window: `/compact` on its own summarizes the conversation and ends the turn, and `/compact <message>` summarizes it and then answers your message. While it runs the CLI shows a `Compacting conversation...` progress label that you can cancel with `Esc`, and when it finishes it shows how many steps were summarized and how much smaller the context became.

title.zh-TW: /diff 支援語法上色與折疊，大檔捲動不再凍結
title.en: /diff Adds Syntax Highlighting and Folding, Ending Scrolling Freezes on Large Files

body.zh-TW: 在終端機核對程式碼變更時，面對落落長的未改動文字往往難以閱讀，遇到超大檔案甚至還會凍結畫面。⟦好比查閱附有彩色便箋的折疊地圖，以前整張大圖攤開難以翻動，現在關鍵標記帶有醒目底色，重複路段也能隨手收折。⟧`/diff` 現在加入語法上色，新增與刪除行帶有底色，各色彩配置也依 token（程式碼語法標記記號）顯示專屬顏色。選用 `Terminal` 配色能自動偵測終端機深淺底色配對顏色，`/config` 與初次安裝也能直接預覽 `/diff` 樣貌。區塊標頭現在會標示上方隱藏的未改動行數，按 `Ctrl+O` 可展開或收合游標處折疊，按 `f` 則切換僅變更或全文；未提交檔案與 diff 一致即可操作，無法使用時頁尾會說明。目前畫面只渲染螢幕可見行，捲動、展開或開啟全文不再凍結；超過 100,000 行或 10 MB 的檔案則停用展開與全文並於頁尾提示。
body.en: When reviewing code changes in the terminal, long stretches of unchanged text are often tedious to read, and unusually large files can even freeze the display. ⟦Like reading a folded map with color-coded sticky notes, unfolding the entire sheet once made navigation cumbersome, but now key markers carry prominent background tints and repetitive routes fold away conveniently.⟧ The `/diff` command now adds syntax highlighting, with tinted backgrounds for added and deleted lines, and each color scheme displays dedicated colors based on tokens (syntax units in code). Selecting the `Terminal` theme automatically detects terminal background tones to match colors, and `/config` as well as initial installation offer direct previews of `/diff`. Block headers now indicate the number of hidden unchanged lines above them. Pressing `Ctrl+O` expands or collapses the fold at the cursor, while pressing `f` toggles between changes-only and full text. These operations work as long as uncommitted files match the diff, and the footer explains when they are unavailable. Currently, only lines visible on screen are rendered, so scrolling, expanding, or opening full text no longer freezes. Files exceeding 100,000 lines or 10 MB disable expansion and full text while showing a footer notice.

items.original:
Added syntax highlighting to the `/diff` file view, with token colors for each color scheme and a background tint on added and removed lines. With the `Terminal` color scheme the CLI detects whether your terminal has a light or dark background and picks matching colors. The color scheme previews in `/config` and first-run setup now show a sample exactly as `/diff` draws it.
Added folding to the `/diff` file view: each hunk header now shows how many unchanged lines are hidden above it, `Ctrl+O` expands or collapses the fold nearest the cursor, and `f` switches between showing only the changes and the whole file. Both keys work on uncommitted changes when the file on disk still matches the diff, and the footer explains when they can't be used.
Improved `/diff` performance on very large files by rendering only the rows on screen, so scrolling, expanding folds, and opening the whole file no longer freeze the CLI. Expanding folds and showing the whole file are turned off for files over 100,000 lines or 10 MB, and the footer says why.

title.zh-TW: 遠端 iTerm2 顏色降級已修復，SSH 連線可享完整色彩
title.en: Remote iTerm2 Color Degradation Fixed, Restoring Full Color Over SSH

body.zh-TW: 透過 SSH 連線使用 iTerm2 時，以前若遇到未轉發 `COLORTERM` 的情況，終端機顯示會被降級成 256 色。現在只要設定了 `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2`，除非 `COLORTERM` 或 `NO_COLOR` 另有指定，否則會直接啟用完整的 24 位元色彩；這項色彩降級問題已經修好，遠端登入時也能正常顯示鮮明配色。
body.en: When using iTerm2 over an SSH connection, terminal display previously degraded to 256 colors if `COLORTERM` was not forwarded. Setting `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2` now directly enables full 24-bit color unless `COLORTERM` or `NO_COLOR` specifies otherwise. This color degradation issue has been resolved, allowing vivid color schemes to display normally during remote logins.

items.original: Fixed colors being reduced to 256 colors in iTerm2 over SSH, where `COLORTERM` is not forwarded; the CLI now uses full 24-bit color when `LC_TERMINAL=iTerm2` is set, unless `COLORTERM` or `NO_COLOR` says otherwise.

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援 Rex，長對話折疊與排版更俐落
title.en: Terminal Supports Rex, Bringing Cleaner Folding and Layout to Long Chats

body.zh-TW: 平日盯著終端機跟 AI 密切協作時，最怕畫面捲動卡頓或排版突然亂掉。⟦好似在翻閱排版精緻的雜誌，內文欄位整齊對齊邊界，折頁隨手一撥就能俐落展開，不再被折痕切斷字句。⟧現在程式正式支援 Rex 終端機與 OSC 7501 控制序列。終端機裡的工具呼叫群組在有新操作加入時會持續維持展開，長對話中按下 `Ctrl+E` 展開或收折思考過程也更加迅速。如果提示詞或引號裡的超連結因為文字過長而折行，點擊時依然能正確連向完整網址。模型回覆裡的行內標籤不會再破壞版面排版。在工作階段內用來恢復舊工作階段的選單，若設定為不分組，現在會跟歡迎畫面的不分組排版一致。
body.en: Working closely with AI in the terminal, nothing is more frustrating than scrolling stutter or suddenly scrambled formatting. ⟦Picture flipping through a beautifully formatted magazine, where columns align neatly against margins and foldout pages expand smoothly at a touch without creasing through lines of text.⟧ The application now officially supports the Rex terminal and OSC 7501 control sequences. Tool call groups inside the terminal stay expanded when new operations are added, and pressing `Ctrl+E` during long conversations expands or collapses thinking processes much faster. When hyperlinks inside prompts or quotations wrap across lines due to length, clicking them still reliably opens the complete URL. Inline tags within model responses will no longer disrupt layout alignment. In addition, the in-session menu for resuming earlier sessions, when set to ungrouped, now mirrors the ungrouped layout on the welcome screen.

items.original:
Added support for OSC 7501 and the Rex terminal
Expanded tool-call groups stay expanded as new calls join them, and `Ctrl+E` expands or collapses thinking faster in long transcripts
Wrapped URLs in prompts and quotes link to the complete address
Inline tags in agent replies no longer break line layout
The in-session resume picker matches the ungrouped layout on the welcome screen when that layout is configured

title.zh-TW: 子目錄可載入專案掛鉤，狀態列掌握當前回合資訊
title.en: Subdirectories Load Project Hooks, and Status Line Tracks Turn Details

body.zh-TW: 替專案撰寫自動化擴充時，不同目錄的自訂規則現在能精準到位。⟦宛如大樓各樓層的專屬警衛室，進駐該樓層就能啟動當地的巡邏規章，線路故障時當場亮起警示，值班看板也隨時顯示當前任務的接單序號。⟧如果你在儲存庫的子資料夾啟動 grok，該子目錄下的專案掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）現在會正確載入。連往本機 localhost 的 HTTP 掛鉤也能正常運作，若網址填寫錯誤，載入時就會立刻報錯。終端機底部的指令狀態列（statusLine，終端機最底部的即時資訊列）腳本在回合執行期間，也能順利取得當前回合的提示詞識別碼與開始時間。
body.en: When writing automated extensions for a project, custom rules across different directories now apply with precision. ⟦Think of dedicated guard stations on each building floor, where checking into a floor activates local patrol protocols, wiring faults trigger on-the-spot warnings, and duty boards constantly display order sequence numbers for active tasks.⟧ If you launch grok from a subdirectory of a repository, project hooks under that subdirectory will now load correctly. HTTP hooks connecting to local localhost also operate properly, immediately raising an error during loading if a URL is incorrect. Furthermore, command statusLine scripts at the bottom of the terminal can smoothly retrieve the prompt ID and start time of the current turn while the turn runs.

items.original:
Project hooks in a repository subfolder load when you launch inside that folder
HTTP hooks to localhost work, and bad hook URLs are reported at load time
Command status-line scripts see the current turn prompt ID and start time while the turn is active

title.zh-TW: 模型切換重啟不回彈，思考力度參數嚴格校驗
title.en: Model Switches Persist Across Restarts, with Strict Validation for Effort Flags

body.zh-TW: 當你想換個更合適的模型解題時，設定結果現在會老實保存。⟦如同替專業相機切換拍攝模式，轉盤卡住時不會擅自改寫自訂選單，重新開機依然停在最後選定的檔位，調整進階參數時若鏡頭不支援也會亮燈提醒。⟧以前使用 `/model` 切換模型若中途失敗，頁尾顯示和儲存的預設模型仍會被改掉，現在切換失敗會維持原狀。切換成功後重新啟動 grok，也不會再倒退回先前的舊模型。如果你使用 `grok -p --effort` 指定思考力度，程式會直接拒絕無效的力度數值；若目前使用的模型忽略這項參數，也會明確發出警告。
body.en: When switching to a more suitable model to solve a problem, your configuration is now reliably preserved. ⟦Much like switching shooting modes on a professional camera, a jammed dial never silently overwrites custom menus, rebooting preserves the last selected gear, and adjusting advanced parameters illuminates a warning light whenever the lens lacks support.⟧ Previously, if switching models via `/model` failed mid-operation, the footer display and saved default model were still overwritten; now, a failed switch leaves the existing state intact. After a successful switch, restarting grok no longer reverts to the previous model. If you use `grok -p --effort` to specify reasoning effort, the program directly rejects invalid effort values, and it explicitly issues a warning if the active model ignores this parameter.

items.original:
`/model` switches that fail no longer change the footer or the saved default model
`grok -p --effort` warns when the model ignores the flag, and refuses invalid effort levels
Restarting after a model switch no longer reverts to the previous model

title.zh-TW: 檔案匯出拒絕覆寫，大圖拒收與搜尋失敗清楚報錯
title.en: File Exports Block Overwrites, with Clear Errors for Large Images and Failed Searches

body.zh-TW: 整理對話紀錄或搜尋專案內容時，操作遇到阻礙不再默默失敗。使用匯出或複製功能時，若目標檔案已經存在，程式會主動拒絕覆寫並顯示清楚的提示訊息，避免原有內容被蓋掉。在終端機貼上超過 50 MB 的超大圖片時，畫面會跳出明確訊息拒絕接收，不再無聲把圖片吃掉。當工具執行 `grep` 搜尋或使用 `list_dir` 列出資料夾時，若遇到搜尋逾時、執行失敗或目錄無法讀取，現在會明確回報錯誤，不再假裝查無資料而回傳空白。以前遇到這些狀況只能自己瞎猜到底有沒有送出或到底查完了沒，現在每一處阻礙都有清楚說明。
body.en: When organizing conversation logs or searching project contents, blocked operations no longer fail silently. When using export or copy features, if the destination file already exists, the program proactively refuses to overwrite it and displays a clear prompt to keep existing content intact. Pasting an oversized image exceeding 50 MB into the terminal triggers an explicit rejection message instead of silently swallowing the file. When tools execute a `grep` search or use `list_dir` to list folders, any search timeout, execution failure, or unreadable directory now explicitly reports an error instead of returning blank output as if nothing was found. Where you previously had to guess whether an operation was dispatched or finished, every obstacle now comes with clear feedback.

items.original:
Export and copy refuse to overwrite an existing file, and show a clear message
Pasted images over 50 MB are rejected with a clear message instead of being dropped silently
`grep` and `list_dir` report a clear error when a search times out or fails, or the folder cannot be read, instead of returning no results

title.zh-TW: 離開乾淨終止背景指令，取消操作清楚標明對象
title.en: Exiting Cleanly Halts Background Commands, and Cancellations Identify Targets

body.zh-TW: 當你決定按下中斷鍵或退出程式，手邊正在跑的任務現在會乾淨收尾。⟦就像舞台監督透過對講機喊卡，所有燈光與後台機關立刻同步停機，場記板明確記下喊停的幕次，不再發生演員散場而機關還在後台空轉的窘境。⟧以前退出 grok 或發送中斷訊號後，部分背景指令仍會私下繼續佔用資源，現在結束時會老實終止所有由它啟動的子行程。在終端機按下取消時，畫面也會清楚印出究竟是哪一道指令被停止。如果你使用 `/workflow stop` 停止工作流程，程式也能精準鎖定當前真正處於執行中的任務，不會誤停其他進程。
body.en: When you hit the interrupt key or exit the program, active tasks now wrap up cleanly. ⟦A stage manager calls cut over the intercom: stage lights and backstage machinery immediately power down in unison, the clapperboard logs the halted scene, and machinery never idles backstage after the cast departs.⟧ Previously, after quitting grok or sending an interrupt signal, certain background commands continued consuming resources behind the scenes; now, exiting faithfully terminates all child processes spawned by the session. When you trigger a cancellation in the terminal, the screen explicitly displays which command was stopped. If you use `/workflow stop` to halt a workflow, the program accurately targets tasks currently running without mistakenly terminating other processes.

items.original:
Shell commands no longer keep running after you quit grok, or after grok receives a signal
Cancelled terminal commands show the command that was stopped
`/workflow stop` picks the correct live run

title.zh-TW: 審核卡片不再突然消失，授權通知明確指名工作階段
title.en: Review Cards Persist Reliably, and Authorization Prompts Specify Sessions

body.zh-TW: 放手讓 AI 在背景處理複雜任務時，需要你點頭授權的關鍵卡片不再跟你玩捉迷藏。⟦好比總經理桌上的急件待辦夾，各部門送上來的簽呈會蓋妥所屬專案的章戳，送達時自動移開桌面上的大型看圖板，即便主幹部的會議散會，底下助理未簽核的請款單依然好好留在桌前。⟧背景子代理（subagent，負責分工處理特定子任務的代理程式）送出的審核卡片，在父回合結束時不會再無故消失。跳出的審核通知現在會明確標示是哪一個工作階段需要你批准。在極簡模式下如果權限提示與隱藏的計畫或取消面板同時出現，畫面會確實呈現該權限提示。每當審核卡片浮現，程式也會自動關閉區塊檢視器，避免卡片內容遭到遮擋。
body.en: When leaving AI to handle complex tasks in the background, the key approval cards requiring your sign-off will no longer play hide-and-seek. ⟦Consider an executive's urgent pending folder, where incoming petitions from each department are stamped with their respective project marks, large drafting boards slide aside upon arrival, and pending requisitions remain securely on the desk even after the leadership meeting adjourns.⟧ Review cards submitted by background subagents no longer vanish without reason when a parent turn ends. Pop-up authorization notifications now explicitly indicate which session requires your approval. In minimal mode, if a permission prompt coincides with a hidden plan or cancel panel, the screen reliably renders the permission prompt. Whenever a review card appears, the program also automatically closes the block viewer to prevent card content from being obscured.

items.original:
Approval cards for background subagents no longer disappear when the parent turn ends
Approval notifications name the session that needs approval
Minimal mode shows the permission prompt instead of a hidden plan or cancel panel when both are present
Approval cards close the block viewer so the card is visible

title.zh-TW: 工作樹刪除設下嚴格防線，使用中與外部目錄一律拒刪
title.en: Worktree Deletion Enforces Safeguards, Blocking Active and External Folders

body.zh-TW: 清理專案的多重副本時，重要程式碼與進行中的作業現在有更嚴密的保護。⟦恰如租車公司的還車清點機制，只要車輛仍有登記中的租約在路上行駛，就不允許註銷車籍；若開來的不是自家出租的車輛或整間調度場的總鑰匙，也會立刻拒絕受理。⟧使用工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）時，執行 `grok worktree rm` 或 `gc` 垃圾回收清理，若發現有開啟中的工作階段正使用該副本，指令會直接拒絕刪除。`grok worktree rm` 也設下了嚴格的安全防線，一律拒絕刪除任何 Git 儲存庫、`.git` 資料夾或任何非 grok 自行建立的目錄，不再因為手滑誤打指令而釀成災難。
body.en: When cleaning up multiple project copies, essential code and active work receive tighter safeguards. ⟦Rental car return inspections enforce a strict checklist: vehicles with active leases on the road cannot be deregistered, and returning an outside vehicle or a master lot key is turned away on the spot.⟧ When managing worktrees, running `grok worktree rm` or `gc` garbage collection cleanup will directly refuse deletion if an active session is currently using that copy. `grok worktree rm` also erects strict safety boundaries, flatly refusing to remove any Git repository, `.git` directory, or any folder not created by grok itself, preventing mistyped commands from causing disaster.

items.original:
`grok worktree rm` and `gc` no longer delete a worktree that an open session is using
`grok worktree rm` refuses to delete git repositories, `.git` folders, or any directory grok did not create

title.zh-TW: 脈絡溢位觸發自動精簡，對話過長不再當機或循環
title.en: Context Overflow Triggers Compaction, Ending Crashes and Loops in Long Chats

body.zh-TW: 跟 AI 進行長篇對話或調用大量工具時，記憶空間被塞爆的窘境現在有了自動排解機制。⟦彷彿隨行秘書在會議記錄爆量時主動整理精華提要，騰出筆記本空間讓會議繼續進行，若連續重抄三次重點依然爆頁，也會老實停筆確認，不再盲目撕頁重寫。⟧如果工具回合內容過長且包含工具使用後的自訂掛鉤輸出，程式會主動壓縮摘要，不再直接撞上提示詞長度上限。當遇上脈絡溢位（context overflow，對話總長度超出模型單次能處理的容量）錯誤時，程式會自動觸發壓縮，不再讓當前回合直接當掉。為了避免無休止的壓縮消耗資源，自動壓縮只要連續三次填滿脈絡就會主動停下，不再陷入死迴圈。
body.en: During lengthy conversations with AI or extensive tool usage, the frustration of exhausted memory space now has an automatic resolution mechanism. ⟦An executive secretary condenses key highlights as meeting minutes swell, freeing notebook space so discussions proceed, and pauses to verify after overflowing pages three times in a row rather than tearing out sheets blindly.⟧ If a tool turn runs overly long and includes custom post-tool hook output, the program proactively summarizes and compacts the content instead of colliding with prompt length limits. When a context overflow error occurs, the program automatically triggers compaction rather than letting the current turn crash. To prevent runaway compaction from consuming resources, automatic compaction pauses after filling the context three consecutive times, preventing infinite loops.

items.original:
Long tool turns that include PostToolUse hook output compact instead of hitting the prompt length limit
Context overflow errors trigger automatic compaction instead of failing the turn
Auto-compaction stops after three context refills in a row instead of looping

title.zh-TW: 無頭模式自動濾除 BOM，MCP 工具遇無效字元不再逾時
title.en: Headless Mode Filters BOMs, and MCP Tools Avoid Timeouts on Invalid Characters

body.zh-TW: 利用自動化腳本批次餵入提示詞或串接外部服務時，隱形字元造成的離奇錯誤現在已徹底排除。在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視覺介面的執行模式）下，如果提示詞檔案開頭帶有微軟檔案常見的 BOM 位元組順序記號，程式會主動濾除，不再把多餘標記送給模型，也不會弄壞 JSON 提示詞檔。當外部工具透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）回傳結果時，即便內容夾雜無效字元，也不會再導致工具呼叫逾時卡死。以前這些肉眼看不到的編碼符號常在暗處作怪，讓排程任務莫名中斷或卡在等待畫面，現在這類字元解析問題已經修好。⟦就像自動驗票機讀取票卡，以前表面只要沾了看不見的殘膠或夾帶污漬就會卡死閘門，現在能主動濾除干擾順利放行。⟧
body.en: When feeding prompt batches via automation scripts or connecting external services, bizarre errors caused by invisible characters are now eliminated. In headless mode, if a prompt file starts with a BOM byte-order mark common to Microsoft files, the program proactively strips it away, preventing extraneous markers from reaching the model or corrupting JSON prompt files. When external tools return results over MCP, invalid characters in the payload will no longer trigger tool call timeouts or freezes. Where invisible encoding symbols previously caused subtle bugs that abruptly halted scheduled tasks or left processes hanging, character parsing issues of this kind are now resolved. ⟦Automated ticket gates scan transit cards: where invisible adhesive residue or stray smudges once jammed the turnstile, the sensor now filters out surface noise to let passengers through smoothly.⟧

items.original:
Headless prompts that start with a byte-order mark no longer send that mark to the model, and no longer break JSON prompt files
MCP tool replies that contain invalid characters no longer cause the call to time out

title.zh-TW: 背景工作流程支援即時控管，修訂意見核准不遺漏
title.en: Background workflows gain real-time control, preserving revision comments upon plan approval

body.zh-TW:
當你指派耗時較長的自動化任務時，現在可以直接掌握背景作業的即時動態。

⟦像在工廠產線增設了專屬控制台，以前放行的作業只能等它自己跑完，現在每條輸送帶都能隨時按鈕暫停，中途貼上的便箋也會老實留到驗收。⟧

輸入 `/workflow` 即可列出、停止或恢復背景工作流程（依序執行的自動化任務清單），任務面板中也會同步出現這些項目與停止按鈕。執行 `/workflow stop` 或 `/workflow resume` 時，指令會精確對準目前運作中的工作流程。

在計畫修訂執行期間留下的評論，核准計畫時會完整保留並送出。若背景執行的命令發現工作目錄不存在，會立刻回報失敗，不會因為後續傳來殘留輸出而重新切換回執行狀態。
body.en:
When assigning long-running automated tasks, you can now directly track real-time activity for background operations.

⟦Picture a dedicated control console added to a factory floor: tasks once dispatched no longer just run unmonitored to completion, as every conveyor belt can be paused at the press of a button, and notes attached midway stay preserved until final inspection.⟧
